lines.en: I trot through the wood.

lines.zh: 我头上一对角撞着低枝。
lines.en: My pair of horns knocks the low branches.
Head low, nose to the soil.
I move fast, steps light.
I keep at your flank, out of the way.
I catch a sweet smell.
I flick my tail, pleased.

lines.zh: 我的四个脚掌都不出声。
lines.en: My four paws make no sound.

lines.zh: 我在林间空地上转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the clearing.
When I run, my horns lead.
A step, a pause, listening.
I sit with my tail over my feet.
My horns are small. They'll grow.
I hear something running far off.
I'm watching for you to reach into a pocket.
The soil in this wood is loose.
I don't bark. I only watch.

lines.zh: 我的毛色在树影里很难认。
lines.en: In shade, my coat is hard to make out.
I grind my teeth, clicking.

lines.zh: 我的角撞到树干，我甩了甩头。
lines.en: My horn hit the trunk; I shook my head.

lines.zh: 风从两个方向来，我闻不清。
lines.en: Wind from two sides; I can't tell.
I lie by the roots, idle.
Birds in the wood. I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我头上的角，是源石长的。
lines.en: The horn on my head grew from originium.
I look up, horns toward you.
You crouch and I'll come over.
I sniff your trouser leg.
You can touch my horns. I don't mind.
I'm not wild. I know people.

lines.zh: 我的角蹭了蹭你的膝盖。
lines.en: My horn nudges your knee.
Your palm is empty.
I circle at your feet.

lines.zh: 你要是坐下，我就靠过来。
lines.en: If you sit, I'll lean on you.
My tail is wagging.

lines.zh: 你的鞋上有林子里的泥。
lines.en: There's forest mud on your boots.
I keep my head up, watching you.
I put my nose to your hand.
If you don't shoo me, I'll stay.
I give you half the path.
I wait for you to decide.
I flinch and back off.

lines.zh: 鬣狗的笑，从角下面出来。
lines.en: A hyena's laugh comes from under my horn.
I tuck my tail and run off.

lines.zh: 源石碎片从我背上滚落。
lines.en: Originium shards roll off my back.
I whimper and slip into the bushes.
I don't like pain.
I grit my teeth and keep my hind legs pushing.
Enough; I give in.
I like that smell.
I ease closer.
Lower it and I'll eat.
Sniff first, then bite.
A little horn sits on my head.

lines.zh: 我啃得很快，连渣都不剩。
lines.en: I gulp it down, crumbs and all.
Better than the forest's fare.
I lie down and gnaw slowly.

lines.zh: 你手别伸过来，我会护食。
lines.en: Don't reach over; I guard my food.
I've licked up the crumbs.
Done, I rub against your leg.
Give me this and I'll follow you all day.
I carry it off to one side.
One more and I won't leave.
I look up, waiting for more.
Too hard. I can't bite it.
These teeth are made for this.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的角，我偏了头。
lines.en: You touched my horn; my head tilted.
I back off half a meter and look at you.

lines.zh: 我的角勾住了你的裤脚。
lines.en: My horn snagged your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我绕你半圈，角差点顶到你。
lines.en: I circle half around you, my horn nearly catching you.
That bump was me playing.
I shake, coat bristling.
Your hand touched my ear.
I dodge around you and run a circle.
That knock doesn't upset me.
I sit leaning against your leg.

lines.zh: 林子里还有别的鬣犄兽。
lines.en: There are other horn-hyenas in the wood.
We touch noses.
Its horns are longer than mine.
We chase one insect together.

lines.zh: 它替我叼走耳后的枯枝。
lines.en: It plucks the dead twig from behind my ear.
It pushes its leftovers to me.
It licks my ear.
Before dark, each to its den.
Tomorrow, in the wood again.
I bury it under the tree.
I gnaw at this bead.
I paw at something on the ground.
I carry it to your feet.
This iron is heavy; I drag it.

lines.zh: 我闻了一下，不太感兴趣。
lines.en: I sniff. Not very interested.
I check what fell first.
I hide it in a shrub.
Done, I run back to you.

lines.zh: 林子那边的石头味带着铁锈。
lines.en: The stone smell from the treeline carries rust.
I'm in front of you now.
All four feet grip the ground.
It's to our right.
I'll gore with my horns here.
This forest is mine to guard.
Don't move. I already have your scent.
My horns are already aimed at you.
It went behind a tree; I circle.
I keep my nose to the ground.
The gap is closing.
It changed direction.
I won't rush; I can keep up.
The branch it broke is still creaking.
I close in step by step.
The wind helps, carrying its scent.
It backed downhill. Poor footing.
I wait for it to stop.

lines.zh: 我的角尖先抵上它的胸口。
lines.en: The tip of my horn meets its chest first.
My horn catches its leg.
I bite its clothing.
That one carried my whole run.
It backed off; I circle it.
I rake its feet with my claws.
I staggered from my own charge.
It dropped into a sit.
My teeth are sharp.
That should make it remember me.
One more shadow in the wood.
First I smell the ground here.
My horns catch the morning light.
I stop under a tree.
There are insects here, and food.
I shake the dew from my coat.
I run down the earth bank.
This ground smells good.

lines.zh: 火燎了我的毛，一股焦味。
lines.en: Fire singes my coat. Burnt smell.
The landing makes my legs go weak.
I thrash toward the bank.
The bang sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 箭头在我肋骨上划出一道白痕。
lines.en: The arrowhead leaves a white streak across my ribs.
A flash and I freeze.
Hunger makes me sway.
Thunder flattens me.
I fall, paws flailing.
